build_COMACritic: build a COMACritic network for counterfactual multi-agent reinforcement learning using PyMARL scheme and args
run_COMACritic_forward: run the COMACritic forward pass on a batch to compute Q-values for all agents
review_COMACritic_build_inputs: review the COMACritic _build_inputs method that concatenates state, observations, actions, and agent IDs
refactor_COMACritic_layers: refactor the COMACritic fc1, fc2, fc3 linear layers to use configurable hidden dimensions
summarize_COMACritic_get_input_shape: summarize the COMACritic _get_input_shape method that calculates total input dimension from the scheme
